visualization_design.geographic_map: bus points, boundary, contextual roads; no topology connectors
visualization_design.reason: Geographic coordinates and abstract branch adjacency were generated independently; separate figures prevent straight-line overlays from being mistaken for feeder routes.

connector_geometry_review.interpretation: Previous 158 nonincident crossings are cartographic only; they do not justify bus relocation or topology changes.

limitations: Bus coordinates are synthetic, not actual Taipower assets or verified loads.
OSM roads are context, not electrical corridors.
Abstract topology layout has no geographic meaning.
Straight-line coordinate distances are not conductor lengths or impedances.
No electrical power-flow, protection, reliability, islanding, BESS, or operational feasibility is validated.
